title: Minigame: A12.14 concealment lost on advancing

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as a minigame of the Rules-first plan's proving slice (section 8): a concealed squad advancing in view of an enemy, on an imported board.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): the units are set up by hand, a concealed German squad next to Open Ground and a Good Order Russian squad within 16 hexes.

introduction: A concealed squad advances across open ground in front of the enemy.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
